metadata.title: Synthetic Clinical Protocol Library
metadata.synthetic_data_notice: Synthetic data only — no real patient data.
metadata.description: Illustrative protocol library defining textbook standards of care and 4-tier recommendation ladders for teleconsultation decision-support.

protocols.title: Condition Alpha: Acute Progressive Soft-Tissue & Peripheral Infection Protocol
protocols.textbook_recommendation: Immediate parenteral broad-spectrum antimicrobial administration, urgent Doppler ultrasound within 6 hours to rule out deep fascial extension, surgical specialist consultation within 24 hours, and continuous wound observation in an inpatient surgical unit.

preferred.option: Initiate IV third-generation cephalosporin + Doppler ultrasonography + specialist surgical debridement evaluation within 12-24 hours.
preferred.rationale: Textbook gold standard to arrest rapid microbial spread and preserve tissue integrity.

resource_adapted_alternative.option: Oral high-potency fluoroquinolone or co-amoxiclav with strict limb elevation, povidone-iodine dressing, serial digital wound margin tracing by local health worker, and teleconsultation re-evaluation in 12 hours.
resource_adapted_alternative.rationale: Feasible when advanced Doppler imaging and cold-chain IV infusion are unavailable locally; leverages local oral dispensary stock and digital serial photos.

minimum_safe_fallback.option: Standard oral amoxicillin/clavulanic acid or co-trimoxazole, sterile dressing, complete immobilization, and mandatory bedside vital sign checks every 6 hours by LHW.
minimum_safe_fallback.rationale: Basic anti-infective coverage to prevent sepsis when communication links and secondary diagnostics are completely severed.

escalate_only.option: Emergency ambulance transfer to secondary taluk hospital with cold-pack wound stabilization and intravenous fluid access.
escalate_only.rationale: Mandatory escalation when local oral stock is exhausted, spreading erythema crosses anatomical landmarks, or systemic fever develops.

protocols.title: Condition Beta: Sub-Acute Decompensated Glycemic & Metabolic Instability Protocol
protocols.textbook_recommendation: Comprehensive laboratory panel (HbA1c, venous blood glucose, serum ketones, serum electrolytes), initiation of weight-based subcutaneous refrigerated basal insulin regimen, dietary endocrinology counseling, and scheduled 24-hour endocrinologist tele-review.

preferred.option: Refrigerated basal-bolus subcutaneous insulin titration + daily venous metabolic profile + direct endocrinologist supervision via teleconsultation.
preferred.rationale: Rapidly stabilizes glucotoxicity and protects pancreatic beta-cell reserve using optimal physiological insulin replacement.

resource_adapted_alternative.option: Maximized dual oral hypoglycemic regimen (Metformin + Glimepiride from verified sub-center inventory), paired with local capillary fingerstick blood glucose logging (fasting + post-prandial) managed by LHW.
resource_adapted_alternative.rationale: Effective glycemic control achieved without requiring uninterrupted refrigeration or specialized laboratory technicians.

minimum_safe_fallback.option: Single-agent oral Metformin titration with strict dietary carbohydrate restriction, hydration encouragement, and twice-daily urine glucose dipstick assessment.
minimum_safe_fallback.rationale: Safe maintenance baseline preventing hyperosmolar crisis when secondary oral agents are unavailable.

escalate_only.option: Urgent transfer to taluk referral facility if capillary glucose exceeds 350 mg/dL or if patient exhibits altered sensorium, vomiting, or Kussmaul respiration.
escalate_only.rationale: Pre-empts fatal diabetic ketoacidosis or hyperosmolar hyperglycemic state requiring intensive intravenous rehydration.

protocols.title: Condition Gamma: Acute Hemodynamic & Neurologic Vulnerability Protocol
protocols.textbook_recommendation: Immediate emergency non-contrast brain computed tomography (CT) within 60 minutes, tertiary neurologist intervention, continuous 12-lead electrocardiographic telemetry, and intravenous neurovascular thrombolytic/anticoagulant evaluation.

preferred.option: Rapid emergency medical transport to stroke-ready tertiary center with simultaneous CT acquisition, neurologist consult, and acute vascular intervention.
preferred.rationale: Maximizes neurological penumbra rescue within the critical 3-to-4.5-hour therapeutic window.

resource_adapted_alternative.option: Immediate high-flow oxygen, continuous blood pressure monitoring, airway aspiration protection, and prioritized ambulance transit with remote neurologist video guidance en route.
resource_adapted_alternative.rationale: Stabilizes vital organ perfusion and prevents hypoxia during transfer when local imaging is absent.

minimum_safe_fallback.option: Supportive positioning (30-degree head elevation), clear airway maintenance, vital sign logging every 15 minutes by LHW, and immediate family mobilization for local conveyance.
minimum_safe_fallback.rationale: Basic life-support stabilization while emergency transportation is arranged.

escalate_only.option: Immediate Tier-3 code activation: dispatch emergency transfer vehicle to nearest facility with resuscitation capability.
escalate_only.rationale: Critical physiological decompensation cannot be safely managed in peripheral setting.

protocols.title: Condition Delta: Primary Chronic Cardiovascular & Hypertension Protocol
protocols.textbook_recommendation: Comprehensive baseline 12-lead ECG, serum creatinine, lipid profile, initiation of combination ACE-inhibitor/calcium channel blocker, lifestyle modification counseling, and 72-hour blood pressure re-assessment.

preferred.option: First-line fixed-dose combination anti-hypertensive (Amlodipine + Telmisartan), automated home BP monitor provided, structured lifestyle/dietary guidance in preferred language.
preferred.rationale: Rapid achievement of target blood pressure (<130/80 mmHg) with high adherence through single-pill combination therapy.

resource_adapted_alternative.option: Generic single-agent oral Amlodipine (5 mg daily) from sub-center dispensary, scheduled bi-weekly BP checks at village health post by LHW, verbal dietary salt reduction advice in vernacular language.
resource_adapted_alternative.rationale: Achieves reliable pressure reduction utilizing widely stocked essential generic medication without requiring personal home digital cuff.

minimum_safe_fallback.option: Standard Hydrochlorothiazide or generic beta-blocker from village kit, accompanied by lifestyle counseling and monthly manual sphygmomanometer check.
minimum_safe_fallback.rationale: Basic reduction of long-term cardiovascular risk when modern dual-agent pills are out of stock.

escalate_only.option: Urgent referral to secondary medical officer if systolic BP persistently exceeds 180 mmHg or if patient reports new-onset headache, visual blur, or chest discomfort.
escalate_only.rationale: Pre-empts hypertensive emergency with acute end-organ damage.

protocols.title: Condition Epsilon: Reactive Airway Bronchospasm & Respiratory Distress Protocol
protocols.textbook_recommendation: Metered-dose inhaler (MDI) with spacer device for short-acting beta-2 agonist (Salbutamol) and inhaled corticosteroid (Budesonide), peak expiratory flow rate (PEFR) spirometry monitoring, pulse oximetry tracking, and 24-hour pulmonologist review.

preferred.option: Salbutamol + Budesonide MDI via spacer, continuous pulse oximetry, peak flow measurement before and after bronchodilator, and 24-hour remote tele-pulmonology review.
preferred.rationale: Targeted airway therapy with immediate topical bronchodilation and anti-inflammatory suppression with objective lung function metrics.

resource_adapted_alternative.option: Oral Salbutamol or Theophylline derivative, paired with local portable electric/foot-pump nebulization if available, pulse oximetry checks by LHW, and respiratory rate counting.
resource_adapted_alternative.rationale: Relieves bronchospasm using accessible oral/nebulized dispensary formulations when proprietary inhaler spacers are unavailable.

minimum_safe_fallback.option: Short-course oral prednisolone (30 mg daily for 3 days), steam inhalation, hydration, and resting in upright sitting position under direct observation.
minimum_safe_fallback.rationale: Provides systemic anti-inflammatory action to reverse airway edema in remote settings without inhaler stocks.

escalate_only.option: Immediate oxygen-equipped transport to hospital if peripheral oxygen saturation (SpO2) falls below 90% or if patient exhibits intercostal retractions or inability to speak in full sentences.
escalate_only.rationale: Indicates impending respiratory fatigue and failure necessitating high-flow oxygen and mechanical ventilatory support.
